reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first query helper and the existing per-provider link functions, adding one check called from each.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; each of the five link functions only calls it.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the handlers, while the tree already keeps link-time bank logic (findOrCreateBank) in accounts/link.ts, which would have been the more natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard and its five call sites are added.

maintainability.why: Simple, readable single helper, but it comes without tests and with call lines that exceed the repo's formatting width.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider link function calls assertBankAccountNotLinked; nothing re-implements the query.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts holds the rule (provider + account_id, tombstone = 0, excluding upgradingId) and all five link paths call it.
